name: song-vlog-ai
description: 曲影 AI · 音乐变 Vlog — Vite + TypeScript + Capacitor

scripts.test: python3 scripts/generate-test-audio.py && npm run build && npx tsx scripts/test-core.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cp -r test-fixtures dist/ && npm run preview

scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
